chunks: Jarrah al-Mada'ini narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Eat on the Day of Eid al-Fitr before you pray, and do not eat on the Day of Eid al-Adha until the Imam departs."

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: The Imam leading the Eid prayer.
key_terms.اِطْعَمْ: Eat; an instruction concerning the proper practice on Eid.
key_terms.تُصَلِّيَ: You perform the prayer; here referring to the Eid prayer.
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفَ: He departs or finishes and leaves.
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْأَضْحَى: The Day of Eid al-Adha, the festival of sacrifice.
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ: The Day of Eid al-Fitr, marking the end of sawm (fasting).

ai.seo_question: When should one eat on Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling regarding eating on the two Eid days. It instructs that one should eat before the Eid al-Fitr prayer, while on Eid al-Adha one should refrain from eating until after the Imam has finished and departed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2054 - It is narrated from Jarrah al-Mada'ini, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Eat on the Day of Eid al-Fitr before you pray, but do not eat on the Day of Eid al-Adha until the Imam has completed the prayer and returned."
